info.name: A free string text search, intended to be an ambiguous/fuzzy search.

params.name: format
params.description: The format the response will be returned in.

params.name: maxresults
params.description: The maximum number of results to return. Minimum = 1. Maximum = 100. Default = 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the list of returned results by this amount.

params.name: bounds
params.description: Biases the results to a certain area. The <BoundingBox> is a British National Grid bounding box in the form: XMIN,YMIN,XMAX,YMAX

params.name: fq
params.description: Filters the results by bounding box or local_type.

info.name: Find the features closest to a given point

params.name: point
params.description: A set of British National Grid coordinates to which the nearest record in a straight line should be found.

params.name: radius
params.description: The radius in metres to search within. Minimum = 0.01, Maximum = 1,000 . Default = 100
